name: Grupo Multilaser S.A.
summary: Grupo Multilaser S.A. develops, manufactures, distributes, and sells electronic products in Brazil. It provides blenders, fryers, pans, ovens, mixer, coffee makers, kettles, sandwich makers, food warmer, scales, omelette maker, hood, food processors, parts, and accessories for mixers. It also offers vacuum cleaners, circulators, heaters, fans, iron, vaporizer, drinking fountain, popcorn maker, wineries, and ice machines; and electric toothbrush refill, oral irrigator, compressor inhaler, mesh inhaler, air humidifier, aroma diffuser, oximeter, medication spacer, essential oils, scented candles, electric toothbrush, irrigator nozzles and accessories.
